content.content: deccy new writes a skeleton that is schema-valid at creation and never authors node content: type text, ref inline with placeholder content, placeholder rationale, and depends_on naming exactly the --on ids and no others. The skeleton's kind is not fixed here: it is deferred, not dropped, to the decision that owns the kind split (pzquqmrq), and nothing else about the skeleton moves.
content.rationale: D0 forbids the CLI from authoring node content; relaxing the schema re-opens D1d and weakens every validity gate. A placeholder skeleton keeps every birth schema-valid at creation while leaving all content decisions to the author.
